baseline: per-task most common training answer, lexical tie break; no test labels or pretrained models

data.family_policy: arithmetic unordered absolute operand pair across signs/operations; fold sorted nonzero absolute multiset across signs/permutations/zero insertion; lattice base coordinate across tasks/carriers/corruptions
data.split_policy: SHA256 rank of workload/seed/family; first floor(0.8*N) train; next max(1,floor(0.1*N)) validation; rest test

gates.cost_margin: paired training wall ratio <=1.25; latent float32 byte ratio <=1; descriptive only
gates.failure: any missing/failed worker or invalid pairing suppresses aggregates; dense train floor failure blocks held-out scoring for every lane
gates.learning_adequate: all seeds, all tasks: train >=0.90, held-out >=0.50 and held-out >= training-majority baseline +0.10
gates.quality_margin: quantized minus dense held-out family macro >=-0.05; interpret only with useful dense learning gate
gates.test_unlock: all dense workload/seed cells verified and every task train exact answer+EOS >=0.90; all 27 training workers terminate first; decision retained before any held-out evaluation

primary: final-step unconstrained greedy complete answer plus EOS; per-task and family macro accuracy; all seeds retained
scope: visible newly generated finite software/learning characterization; no fresh confirmatory general reasoning or independent replication; classical CPU float32; no quantum or packed speedup claim
selection: final update only; no early stopping, validation selection, test tuning or post-outcome budget changes

training.selection: final-step; no early stopping; no test evaluation

uncertainty: raw counts, paired seed differences, mean/min/max; descriptive only
